purpose: Add offline, fail-closed consumer-observability verifiers and publish a sanitized maintenance-readiness assessment without a cutover.
allowed_operations: read-only OpenClaw, process, SQLite, Git, and secret-scan projections
prohibited_actions: stop, start, or restart any Core Binding, OpenClaw Gateway, or Project Gateway
modify production configuration, Agents, Bindings, Cron, OAuth, models, or PROJECT_STATUS.yaml
connect to Feishu or OpenClaw RPC
send a Feishu message, attachment, or card
emit credentials, raw Feishu identifiers, endpoint values, or local sensitive paths
commit, push, tag, or create P0_READY
rollback: All added verifiers are offline and read-only. No runtime or configuration state is changed.
secrets: Artifacts retain only hashes, counts, booleans, abstract evidence labels, and redacted timestamps.
